title: TokenPricing
description: pricing/token.json: where the run's copy of the pricing datasheet (pricing/datasheet.json, stored byte for byte) came from. The datasheet itself is not committed anywhere: its terms are not reviewed.

url_basis.description: Why this URL: the RunSpec's token_pricing.url, the install's price book (token_pricing.from_price_book), the Bifrost target's framework_config.pricing_url, or Bifrost's default.
